summary: Download the chart with helm repo add openshift-helm-charts https://charts.openshift.io/, helm pull openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal --version x.y.z, extract it, replace all image: references in values.yaml with your disconnected registry paths, and helm package it again.
questions: How do I download the portal Helm chart for offline install?
What is the portal chart name in the OpenShift Helm repo?
How do I change image references in the portal chart?

answer_card.title: Prepare the portal chart for air-gapped use
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
helm repo add openshift-helm-charts https://charts.openshift.io/
helm repo update
helm pull openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal --version x.y.z
tar -xvf redhat-rhaap-portal-x.y.z.tgz
# edit redhat-rhaap-portal/values.yaml: point every image: at your disconnected registry
helm package redhat-rhaap-portal-x.y.z
```
